L1 REWORK · head `a17d2c75bfddbbd6e5128f11aa30107b28251027` · 2026-11-22T10:29Z

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:应用里按 ⌘K 搜到记录时,面板变宽,右边只读显示选中那条记录;上下键切换时,右边跟着换。输入内容后,列表末尾会出现「新建『输入的词』为某对象」;输入「新建」或对象名,会出现「新建某对象」。面板底部写明按回车会做什么。
- 为什么做:卡 #36286 第一步(第 1–4 项)。第 5 项「当前页面」那一组留给同一张卡的第二个 PR。
- 出错会怎样:最多是面板显示或跳转不对,不碰数据,可以整体撤回。搜什么、怎么排序都没变。
- 要你做什么:无。
- 席位意见:REWORK,只有一项:`Clause-②` 声明行要改。功能本身我读下来是对的,「新建为…」打开对象的新建页这一读法我认可,见下面。

## 要改的(1 项)

1. **`Clause-②` 应为 `yes (widening)`。** 本 PR 在每个语言包里加了 8 个 `console.commandPalette.*` 键。`@object-ui/i18n` 构建出的 `dist/locales/en.d.ts` 会把每个键都类型成只读字面量,所以新增键就是放宽;本仓库一直按 `yes (widening)` 声明(#28552、#29186;今天的 #36385、#36343 也都是这样)。请把 changeset `36286-palette-preview-create.md` 和 PR 正文里的 `Clause-②: no` 都改成 `Clause-②: yes (widening)`,并写明新增的 8 个键;changeset 里「No props or package exports change」这句可以保留,它本身是对的。这样声明面就要过一次 L2,请席位安排。只改文本,我做增量审核时只核这一行加 CI。

## 席位核对(本轮已读,增量时不重读)

- 形态:`l1-face --pr 36387`:first-line 是 `Part of #36286`,并写明这是第一步、第 5 项留给第二个 PR,所以用 `Part of` 是对的;卡要保留 `pm:dispatched`。changeset 那一项的标记我清掉了:`@object-ui/components` 只改了两个 `src/__tests__/` 测试,这个包的 `files` 是 `dist`、`README.md`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`LICENSE`,测试不会发布。读的时候 Check Changeset 还在跑(10:26 开始),其余 46 项 success。改动 20 个文件,+959 −11;`check-governed-merges` 判定 NOT governed。
- 席位要我判断的读法:「新建为…」打开的是对象的新建页 `/apps/APP/OBJECT/new?标题字段=输入的词`,而不是列表上的新建弹窗。**我认可这一读法,不算偏离卡面**:卡上写的是「打开对应对象的新建表单,名称已填好」,验收写的是「回车后打开新建客户表单,客户名称已填好」,并没有要求弹窗。而且面板是全局的,不一定在列表页上打开;`RecordFormPage` 本来就会把 query string 读成新建预填(RecordFormPage.tsx:116–129),相关列表的「+ 新建」用的也是这条路。如果要改成在列表页上弹窗,需要改 `AppContent` 的 `handleEdit`,超出本 PR 的文件范围,dev 已在正文写明。
- 一点提醒(不改判):右边详情只显示对象**已声明的** `highlightFields`,没声明的对象只显示标题。这是 `RecordPreviewCard` 已有的规则,来自记录页「没声明就不挑」的裁决。卡上的验收「右边显示这家客户的行业、电话、邮箱」只有在那个「客户」对象声明了 key fields 时才成立。dev 在正文里写明了这一点;如果维护者是在自建应用「客户」上验收,席位最好事先确认那个对象有没有声明。
- 实现读法:可新建的判断和列表的「新建」走同一套:`resolveAffordance('listNew')`,再加上新建动作在工具栏范围内的 `visibleWhen`(失败时关闭)和 `disabledWhen`(失败时放行);被灰掉的「新建」在面板里不出现。预填只写入 `resolveNameField` 解析出的字段,而且要求它是 text/textarea、不是只读、成员在新建时有写权限,这样输入的词一定能落到表单里。最多 3 行,当前页面的对象排第一。预览在选中项停留 150ms 后才读取记录,并丢弃已经过期的回答;45rem 以下靠容器查询隐藏右栏。
- 文本:changeset 与 app-shell README 新增的那一段,逐句和 diff 一致(除第 1 项)。zh-Hans 的文案已核。
- 测试证据:新文件 15 条用例,包括预览、下键只读停住的那条(`findOne` 依次是 C1、C2,没有多读)、容器查询、没命中时不显示右栏、新建行的顺序、无权限对象不出现、清空后新建行消失、回车提示,以及 `visibleWhen`/`disabledWhen` 和标题字段可写这两条判断。截图三张(搜到、搜不到、「新建」)已附在正文,另有英文版。这些用例我没有在本地重跑,读的是报告和 CI。
- 落地条款:非受管;本项改完后做增量 L1,加上声明面 L2,之后由区 ready + auto-merge;`Part of` ⇒ 卡保留 `pm:dispatched`。

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `dcb510f0a1686a61a0b35fdfb71698c281f97a5f`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #36286 body and all six comments (triage, claim with its Clause-② amendment, both os-dev-reports), PR #36387 body and its three comments (final-head notes for a17d2c75 and dcb510f0, L1 REWORK 7077829267), the 20-file list, the net diff against main (merge base ed33f8aedce), and the check-runs on this head. Check-runs: 47 success, 15 skipped, 0 failure, none pending. The skipped runs are the usual path-filtered and opt-in jobs.

### ① Derived judgments

- Published language packs, right. `@object-ui/i18n` gains eight keys under `console.commandPalette`: `create`, `createAs`, `previewEmpty`, `enterOpenRecord`, `enterCreate`, `enterSwitchApp`, `enterApplyTheme`, `enterOpen`. Each of the eleven packs gets all eight. No existing key or English value changes. The built d.ts types each key as a literal, so this is a widening of a published surface.
- The packs carry real translations, right. ar, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru and zh-Hans each hold their own wording, with the locale's own quote marks around the query in `createAs`. zh-Hant is the `gen:zh-hant` output of zh-Hans, as the repo generates it. The de quote-pair pin moves to 124 for the one new pair. The i18n gates and the i18n test shards are green on this head.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` public surface, right. No package export and no prop changes. `paletteCreate.ts`, `PalettePreviewPane.tsx` and `PaletteEnterHint.tsx` are not re-exported from the package entry. The package `exports` map is unchanged.
- Create door, right. The palette adds no new way to create. A create row navigates to the existing `/apps/APP/OBJECT/new` route, which `RecordFormPage` already serves and already reads as a query-string prefill (the related-list New uses the same route). The save goes through that page's normal create path, and the server still checks the create grant. Nothing can be created that could not be created before.
- Create permission check, right. `paletteMayCreate` calls `resolveAffordance('listNew', ...)` with the same object definition, the same `usePermissions()` reader and the same inputs that `ObjectView` passes for its New button. It then binds the create action's toolbar `visibleWhen` (fails closed) and `disabledWhen` (fails soft, declared-ness outside the eval) with no record, exactly as `useObjectViewToolbarAffordances` does through `useRowPredicate`. `evalRowPredicate` treats a null row and an empty row the same way. In the app shell the palette and `ObjectView` sit under the same `ExpressionProvider`, so the predicate scope matches. The objects offered are the app's navigation objects after the member nav gates. The test file pins an object without a create grant as never offered.
- Prefill accept-set, right. The prefill writes only the title field from `resolveNameField`, and only when it is a `text` or `textarea` field, not `readonly`, that `resolveFieldAffordance('createFormFields', ...)` lets the member write. The value is URL-encoded with `URLSearchParams`. The typed words render as a React text node with `escapeValue: false`, so they are not read as markup.
- Preview read path, right. The pane reuses `RecordPreviewCard` unchanged. It reads the record by id through the palette's own `dataSource.findOne`, the normal data path the server enforces. Its `$expand` list keeps only reference fields that `perms.checkField(..., 'read')` allows, and it draws only the object's declared `highlightFields`. A failed read draws one cause-free state. The pane only previews records the search already returned to this viewer.
- Layout, right. The wide cap reads `DIALOG_VIEWPORT_GUTTER` and the palette is listed in the gutter census `WIDE_SITES`. The `ui/packages/components` change is a test file only, and that package publishes `dist`, so it needs no changeset entry.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/36286-palette-preview-create.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch and `@object-ui/i18n` patch. These are the two packages whose published files move. Right.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is right. The eight new pack keys are a widening of a published typed surface, and nothing narrows. The line sits at line start in both the changeset body and the PR body, and names the eight keys.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is right. Nothing a metadata author can write changes. The palette reads the existing `highlightFields`, `userActions.create` and title-field ladder.
- AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist 3): a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships patch, and `none` takes patch. Patch on both packages matches. The change is not breaking, so no ADR-0087 marker or migration is owed. Check Changeset and the ADR-0087 registration gate are green on this head.
- The L1 REWORK 7077829267 item (Clause-② no to yes) is done in both the changeset and the PR body. The claim on the card carries the amendment.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Open question, palette create opens the `/new` page or the list's modal. Answered: keep the `/new` page (option A). L1 already accepted this reading, and I agree. The card asks that Enter opens the create form with the name filled, which the page does. The palette is global, so it is often not on a list page. A modal would need new wiring in `AppContent`, outside this claim.
- Open question, the PR-body replacement lines. Answered: the PR body now carries both lines as given.
- Dev flag, key fields are the declared `highlightFields` only. Escalated as a note for the seat, not a code finding. This is `RecordPreviewCard`'s existing rule. The dev's survey says no shipped account or 客户 object declares industry, phone and email together. So the card's acceptance line holds only on an object that declares those fields. The seat should check this on the object the maintainer will accept against before handing it over.
- Dev flags, the README paragraph outside the claimed surface (the ui docs rule), the screenshot orphan ref, and the signature line position. Accepted as stated.
- Dev flag, the textual overlap with open PR #36398 on the de quote-pair pin. Accepted. Whichever PR lands second takes a one-line bump. No change is needed here.
- Reviewer note, not graded. The Home palette binds an empty `features` and `app` scope, unlike the app shell. A create action whose toolbar `disabledWhen` reads those keys would fail soft there and could be offered on Home where the list would grey it. `visibleWhen` still fails closed, the grant check is unchanged, and the target route already exists, so no permission widens. It only qualifies the changeset's "exactly where its list offers New" in that edge case.
- SQL push-down. Clean. There is no new id materialisation and no in-app join. The preview is one by-id `findOne` with server-side `$expand`, and only once the selection rests 150 ms. A reason is given for not reusing the row the hit already carries: the card needs lookups expanded to names. The create rows read metadata and permissions only.
- Security: none found.

No must-fix, no should-fix.
